text:
ashley (Design): quick design scrub — need quick takes on three things: 1) inline errors vs top summary for the account settings form, 2) required-field signalling (asterisk vs explicit 'required' label), 3) confirmation pattern for the Delete workspace flow. mock: https://drive.redwood.design/ux/mocks/account-settings-v3.png :eyes: ben (PM): inline for single-field issues, summary for when 2+ fields fail on submit. keep both but prefer inline-first to reduce cognitive load. :thumbsup: rachel (A11y): agree, but implement aria-live for inline errors and move focus to the first error when showing top summary. a11y note: asterisk alone is not accessible — we need text for screen readers (e.g., "(required)") or use aria-required on the input. :warning: kevin (Frontend): quick feasibility: inline errors + focus-on-first-error is straightforward. top-summary would need a11y anchor + id mapping to fields. snippet I usually use: ```html
2 errors found
``` jamal (Eng): typed-confirm for super-destructive actions still my vote — require full word: DELETE WORKSPACE. reduces accidental clicks more than modal copy. also throttle the API for 5s after confirm to avoid double-submit. sam (Design Ops): mobile density question — if we show inline errors inline on mobile we should compress copy to one short sentence and keep the error icon only on small screens. otherwise the form grows too long. ashley (Design): proposed compromise: show inline validation as user types for single-field rules (format/length). On submit, if multiple errors, reveal a top summary with a short list + link anchors to fields. Required marker: use visible asterisk + visually-hidden "required" text for screen readers. Delete flow: use a small confirm modal w/ typed-confirm for org-level deletes; for single-item delete keep a secondary confirm (undo toast). rachel (A11y): +1 to visually-hidden "required" text. also ensure color contrast on the error text meets AA (4.5:1). I can run the quick audit if you want. :white_check_mark: ben (PM): copy nit for delete modal: current draft "This will delete the workspace and all data" -> prefer: "Deleting this workspace is permanent. Type DELETE to continue." shorter, concrete action-first. kevin (Frontend): implementation note: we'll need a variant for the Dedicated customers who have extra metadata fields — top summary might need pagination. will prototype a11y anchors as separate component. jamal (Eng): edge-case: what if the user corrects fields but validation server-side still errors (unique username)? show top summary with server error at top and attach it to related field via aria-describedby, so screen readers see it in context. a11y-bot: checklist run: color-contrast ✓, focus-order ✓, aria-live for dynamic errors suggested, ensure form-summary has role=alert and focus management on reveal. ashley (Design): next steps — I'll update the mock to show inline + summary interaction, add the visually-hidden required label, and draft delete modal copy. tagging @rachel to run the audit once updated. planned sync tomorrow 11:00am. :calendar:
